name: Cutter Shorts (Denim Cut-Off, Hemmed by Hand)
description: Jeans that lost their lower half — to damage, to heat, or to deliberate cutting — and were hemmed with whatever thread was available. The hem line is rarely straight. Sometimes the raw edge is left intentionally, fraying into a soft border. A Shelf summer staple because they cost nothing extra if you already have ruined jeans. Worn with leggings in winter.
what_it_says: You waste nothing. When something breaks, you find the next use for it.
story_hooks: The lower half of these jeans still exists — someone else is wearing the legs as makeshift sleeves.
A specific pair's denim is cut from jeans that were worn during a notable Shelf incident; someone recognizes the fabric pattern.
